newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann makes offer for Maffei shares.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann makes offer for Maffei shares.

text.p: German engineering group Mannesmann AG said on Thursday it was making an offer to buy all outstanding shares in plastics and defence group Krauss-Maffei AG, offering three Mannesmann shares for each Maffei share.
In a mandatory statement, the company said that the exchange Mannesmann shares offered would be fully entitled to the 1996 dividend.
Mannesmann announced earlier this month that it was integrating Maffei fully into the company and that Maffei shares would be suspended from trade.
Mannesmann has held a majority stake in Krauss-Maffei since 1990. It raised its stake to 96.8 percent in 1995.
